description.value: Buono is a modern Mediterranean restaurant on the Gibsons waterfront, owned and led by Executive Chef Mike Buono, whose Italian heritage drives a menu built around a wood-fired al forno oven. The kitchen specializes in small-plate family-style dining featuring house-made pastas, Neapolitan pizza, fresh crudo, and seasonal produce sourced from local farmers and foragers. A craft cocktail program mirrors the food philosophy — fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced — making it one of the more refined dining stops on the Sunshine Coast.
